seo.title: About MKA sport Events — Sports Company in Nicosia, Cyprus
seo.description: MKA sport Events is a Cyprus-based sports company in Nicosia, founded and led by Marios Andreou. Training camps, international sports events and event organisation in Cyprus.

hero.title: A Cyprus sports company, from the mat to the medal ceremony
hero.text: MKA sport Events works out of Nicosia. We organise training camps, support international competitions and deliver sports events in Cyprus: three services, one team, one island.
hero.imageAlt: A visiting women's football team and their coaches gathered at the bench during a break in a camp match in Cyprus

story.title: Built by people who live and breathe sport
story.p1: We started on the mat, not behind a desk. Our team has competed, coached, refereed finals and worked in championship venues, so when a club asks about warm-up halls, mat thickness or transfer times, the answer comes from experience rather than from a brochure.
story.p2: Everything we do happens in Cyprus. That is deliberate. We know the halls, the hotels, the federations and the people who make an event run, and that local knowledge is what turns a booking into a camp that actually works.
points: Based in Nicosia, working across the whole island
One point of contact for planning, logistics and delivery on the ground
Camps and events supported by our own staff on site

founder.title: Founded and led by Marios Andreou
founder.p1: MKA sport Events was founded by Marios Andreou and is run by him today. In the sport itself he serves as President of the Cyprus Sambo Federation, the national governing body for sambo on the island and a member of the European Sambo Federation (ESF) and the International Sambo Federation (FIAS).
founder.p2: That presidency is his own role in sambo rather than a position held by the company. It does shape how we work: competition rules, the fixture calendar, referee and officiating practice and the technical standards a championship hall has to meet are all familiar ground for our team.
founder.imageAlt: The MKA sport Events training camp banner beside the goal on a grass pitch, with a member of the camp team alongside it

items.title: Reliable weather
items.text: More than 300 days of sunshine a year, so outdoor sessions are not lost to the forecast, even in January.

items.title: Easy to reach
items.text: Direct flights from most European capitals to Larnaca and Paphos, with short transfers to the camp base.

items.title: Facilities for your sport
items.text: Grass and artificial pitches, indoor halls with mats, gyms and pools, booked for your group and your dates.

items.title: Value for money
items.text: Competitive package prices, especially outside the summer peak: ideal for winter and spring camps.

items.q: How far in advance should we book?
items.a: As early as your season plan allows. Winter and spring dates are popular with visiting squads, so send your preferred dates and a second option and we will confirm availability.

items.q: Can we bring our own coaching staff and programme?
items.a: Yes. That is how every camp works: your head coach keeps control of the training plan and we build the venues, transport and schedule around it.

items.q: What is the minimum group size?
items.a: There is no fixed minimum. Tell us how many athletes and staff are travelling and we will quote for that group.
Full board is buffet-style with soft drinks, juice, water and coffee, and the meal plan is agreed with your coaching staff.

items.q: Can you organise excursions on rest days?
items.a: Yes. Excursions across Cyprus are available on request and quoted separately.

items.q: Which airport should we fly into?
items.a: Larnaca is the closest airport to the Agia Napa base; Paphos also works. Airport transfers are arranged on request.

sambo.title: Sambo, understood from the inside
sambo.p1: Our founder, Marios Andreou, is President of the Cyprus Sambo Federation, the national governing body for sambo on the island and a member of the European Sambo Federation (ESF) and the International Sambo Federation (FIAS). sambo.p2: It shapes what we bring to an event: competition rules, mat layouts and technical standards, referee and officiating practice, and the accreditation, hotel and transport needs of visiting delegations. We work to those standards on every sambo event we support in Cyprus.

seo.title: Cyprus as Your Training and Event Destination | MKA sport Events
seo.description: Why Cyprus works for training camps and sports events: climate, airports, our Agia Napa camp base, the facilities we book and the official Cyprus Sports Organisation venue map.

hero.title: Cyprus as your training and event destination
hero.text: Year-round training weather, two international airports, a beachfront camp base and halls and pitches across the island. Here is what the destination gives your camp or event, and how we book the right facility for it.
hero.imageAlt: A footballer in an orange shirt shielding the ball from a defender in white during a camp friendly on a grass pitch in Cyprus

regions.title: One island, short distances
regions.text: We are based in Nicosia and work across Cyprus. These are the places that matter most for a visiting group:

items.title: Nicosia
items.text: Our home base and the capital. Company office at Chilis 28, and the city where the first World University Sambo Championships were held in 2016.

items.title: Agia Napa
items.text: Our training-camp base: a four-star beachfront hotel with a floodlit artificial-grass pitch, gym, pool and massage room.

items.title: Larnaca
items.text: The island's main international airport and the host city of the 2024 World Cadet, Youth and Junior Sambo Championships.

items.title: Limassol and Paphos
items.text: Cyprus's second international airport is at Paphos. Both cities have halls and pitches we can book for camps and events.

climate.title: Built for winter and spring camps

items.title: 300+ days of sunshine
items.text: Outdoor sessions are not lost to the forecast, even in January.

items.title: Two international airports
items.text: Direct flights from across Europe into Larnaca and Paphos.

items.title: Short transfers
items.text: Camp bases and venues are a short drive from the airports and from each other.

items.title: Value outside the peak
items.text: Hotels and pitches have capacity in winter and spring, and prices reflect it.

types.title: Facilities matched to your sport
types.text: We book the facility that fits your sport, group size and dates, and handle the paperwork with it.

items.title: Grass and artificial pitches
items.text: Full-size grass pitches with stand seating for matches, a floodlit artificial-grass pitch at the camp base, and FIFA-standard pitches on request.

items.title: Indoor halls with mats
items.text: Halls laid with mats for sambo, judo, wrestling and jiu-jitsu training, and competition layouts for events.

items.title: Gym, pool and recovery
items.text: A fully equipped gym, pool, sauna, jacuzzi, steam room and massage room at the camp base.

items.title: Competition venues
items.text: Halls with spectator seating and space for several competition mats, scoreboards and timing systems.

venues.title: Venues we work with
venues.text: Facility names and photographs are supplied on request while our venue list is being confirmed. Tell us your sport and dates and we will propose the right one.

koa.title: Every registered sports facility in Cyprus, on one map
koa.text: The Cyprus Sports Organisation (KOA) keeps the official public register of sports venues in Cyprus, with an interactive map of every registered facility on the island. Use it to see what exists near your preferred base, then ask us to book it.
